title: Advancements Trophies
description: This adds trophies into your game of Minecraft! This adds trophies that you get at different advancements in game.
body:
🏆 Advancement
 Trophies Celebrate your biggest in-game achievements with style! 
Advancement Trophies is a Minecraft mod that rewards your hard work by granting you beautiful, displayable trophies whenever you complete advancements. 
Transform your survival world base into a personal museum of your greatest victories.


🌟 FeaturesAutomatic Rewards: Earn unique trophies directly in your inventory upon completing advancements.Decorative Displays: Place trophies on tables, shelves, or dedicated trophy rooms to show off your progress.Multiplayer Bragging Rights: Let everyone on your server know exactly who conquered the Ender Dragon or mastered netherite.



👥 Credits & AuthorsMod Creator: Developed and created by @Lightening14567.
